title: Resolve specifiers to files in a node_modules tree
summary: From each of four base directories of a fixture project, resolve a list of relative and bare specifiers (files, directories, packages with main, scoped packages, subpaths, nested node_modules) to absolute file paths, as Node's require does.
notes: A task on the file system: the project is a real directory, created anew before each process and already in the operating system's cache. enhanced-resolve and unrs-resolver cache file system answers in the resolver, so their adapters build the resolver inside every call; Node's own cache cannot be dropped and stays. CPU time includes the kernel's part.
